@@ -0,0 +1,812 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run and retain the four artifact legs for every observed corpus row."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import glob
+import json
+import os
+import platform
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+
+HEAVY = {
+    "bench/std_big_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_bzip2_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_compress_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_csv_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_curve25519_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_digest_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_fuzz_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_gc_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_http_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_mutex_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_password_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_shared_proc_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_tar_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_text_scale_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_toml_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_xml_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_xz_exercise.iyi",
+    "bench/std_zstd_exercise.iyi",
+}
+
+EXIT_ONLY_EXERCISES = {
+    "std_big_exercise",
+    "std_gc_exercise",
+    "std_time_exercise",
+    "std_weak_ref_exercise",
+}
+
+BUILD_TIMEOUT = 300
+RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60
+RUN_HEAVY_TIMEOUT = 300
+DISK_MIN_GB = 20.0
+
+_BUILD_LEGS = ("P", "C1", "C2", "C3")
+_RUN_LEGS = ("P", "C1", "C3")
+
+
+def run_timeout_for(relpath: str, *, run_default_timeout: float = RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, run_heavy_timeout: float = RUN_HEAVY_TIMEOUT) -> float:
+    return run_heavy_timeout if relpath in HEAVY else run_default_timeout
+
+
+def check_disk_space(path: str, min_gb: float = DISK_MIN_GB) -> None:
+    usage = shutil.disk_usage(path)
+    free_gb = usage.free / (1024**3)
+    if free_gb < min_gb:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Disk space below threshold: {free_gb:.2f} GB free < {min_gb:.2f} GB"
+        )
+
+
+def clean_env(repo: str, cache_dir: str, warm: bool = False, extra: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Add only the Run 2 leg variables to the already-scrubbed environment."""
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    for key in tuple(env):
+        if key.startswith("IYI_") or key.startswith("CRYSTAL_"):
+            env.pop(key, None)
+
+    env["IYI_CACHE_DIR"] = cache_dir
+    env["IYI_PATH"] = f"{repo}/src{os.pathsep}{repo}/samples/iyi"
+    env["IYI_LIBRARY_PATH"] = f"{repo}/lib"
+    env["LIBRARY_PATH"] = "/opt/homebrew/opt/bdw-gc/lib"
+    env["PKG_CONFIG_PATH"] = "/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig"
+
+    if warm:
+        env["IYI_WARM"] = "1"
+    if extra:
+        env.update(extra)
+    return env
+
+
+def _kill_process_group(pgid: int, sig: signal.Signals) -> None:
+    try:
+        os.killpg(pgid, sig)
+    except ProcessLookupError:
+        return
+
+
+def run_session_proc(cmd: list[str], cwd: str, env: dict[str, str], timeout_sec: float, stdin_devnull: bool = True) -> tuple[int, bytes, bytes, bool]:
+    """Run one build or program in its own process group."""
+    stdin = subprocess.DEVNULL if stdin_devnull else None
+    proc = subprocess.Popen(
+        cmd,
+        cwd=cwd,
+        env=env,
+        stdin=stdin,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        start_new_session=True,
+    )
+    timed_out = False
+    stdout = b""
+    stderr = b""
+    try:
+        stdout, stderr = proc.communicate(timeout=timeout_sec)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        timed_out = True
+        _kill_process_group(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+        try:
+            stdout, stderr = proc.communicate(timeout=0.5)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            _kill_process_group(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+            stdout, stderr = proc.communicate()
+
+    returncode = proc.returncode if proc.returncode is not None else -1
+    return returncode, stdout, stderr, timed_out
+
+
+def check_defined_symbols(binary_path: str, nm_bin: str) -> list[str]:
+    if not os.path.exists(binary_path):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"binary does not exist for symbol scan: {binary_path}")
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [nm_bin, "-U", binary_path],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        detail = proc.stderr.strip() or proc.stdout.strip()
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"{nm_bin} -U failed (exit {proc.returncode}): {detail}"
+        )
+    return [
+        line.strip()
+        for line in proc.stdout.splitlines()
+        if "__iyi_effect_" in line
+    ]
+
+
+def _compare_frame_stderr(stderr_a: bytes, stderr_b: bytes, repo_root: str, row_dir: str, tag: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    stderr_file_a = os.path.join(row_dir, f"stderr_{tag}_a.out")
+    stderr_file_b = os.path.join(row_dir, f"stderr_{tag}_b.out")
+    with open(stderr_file_a, "wb") as stream:
+        stream.write(stderr_a)
+    with open(stderr_file_b, "wb") as stream:
+        stream.write(stderr_b)
+
+    frames_script = os.path.join(repo_root, "bench/frames_equivalent.py")
+    if not os.path.isfile(frames_script):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"frames_equivalent.py not found at {frames_script}")
+
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, frames_script, stderr_file_a, stderr_file_b],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if proc.returncode == 0:
+        return True, "stdout byte-equal and stderr frames equivalent"
+    if proc.returncode == 1:
+        violation = proc.stdout.strip() or proc.stderr.strip()
+        return False, f"stderr frames equivalence failed: {violation}"
+    raise RuntimeError(
+        "frames_equivalent.py crashed "
+        f"(exit {proc.returncode}): {proc.stderr.strip()}"
+    )
+
+
+def compare_r1(name: str, status_a: int, status_b: int, stdout_a: bytes, stderr_a: bytes, stdout_b: bytes, stderr_b: bytes, repo_root: str, row_dir: str, tag: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:
+    if status_a != status_b:
+        return False, f"exit status mismatch: {status_a} != {status_b}"
+
+    if name in EXIT_ONLY_EXERCISES:
+        return True, "exit-only check passed"
+
+    if stdout_a != stdout_b:
+        difference = f"len {len(stdout_a)} != {len(stdout_b)}" if len(stdout_a) != len(stdout_b) else "differing bytes"
+        return False, f"stdout mismatch ({difference})"
+
+    if stderr_a == stderr_b:
+        return True, "exact stdout and stderr match"
+
+    return _compare_frame_stderr(stderr_a, stderr_b, repo_root, row_dir, tag) if platform.system() == "Darwin" else (False, "stderr differs (frames_equivalent CLI only available on Darwin)")
+
+
+def _row_identity(source: str, repo: str, work_root: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, bool, str]:
+    source_path = os.path.realpath(source)
+    repo_path = os.path.realpath(repo)
+    relpath = os.path.relpath(source_path, repo_path)
+    raw_base = os.path.basename(source_path)
+    base = raw_base[:-4] if raw_base.endswith(".iyi") else raw_base
+    is_std = relpath.startswith(f"bench{os.sep}")
+    row_dir = os.path.join(work_root, "rows", base)
+    return source_path, relpath, base, is_std, row_dir
+
+
+def _empty_row(source: str, repo: str, work_root: str) -> dict:
+    source_path, relpath, base, is_std, row_dir = _row_identity(
+        source, repo, work_root
+    )
+    legs = {
+        leg: {
+            "build": {
+                "exit": None,
+                "timed_out": False,
+                "stdout": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "build", "stdout"),
+                "stderr": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "build", "stderr"),
+            },
+            "run": None,
+        }
+        for leg in _BUILD_LEGS
+    }
+    return {
+        "source": source_path,
+        "name": relpath,
+        "base": base,
+        "kind": "std" if is_std else "sample",
+        "status": "FAIL",
+        "failures": [],
+        "stop_condition": None,
+        "p_exit": None,
+        "c1_exit": None,
+        "c3_exit": None,
+        "callpath": "",
+        "not_reusable_count": 0,
+        "effect_symbols": [],
+        "p_nonzero": False,
+        "preserved_dir": row_dir,
+        "row_dir": row_dir,
+        "legs": legs,
+    }
+
+
+def _output_path(row_dir: str, leg: str, phase: str, stream: str) -> str:
+    return os.path.join(row_dir, f"{leg}.{phase}.{stream}")
+
+
+def _prepare_row_directory(row_dir: str) -> None:
+    shutil.rmtree(row_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+    os.makedirs(row_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    for leg in _BUILD_LEGS:
+        for stream in ("stdout", "stderr"):
+            with open(_output_path(row_dir, leg, "build", stream), "wb"):
+                pass
+    for leg in _RUN_LEGS:
+        for stream in ("stdout", "stderr"):
+            with open(_output_path(row_dir, leg, "run", stream), "wb"):
+                pass
+        with open(_output_path(row_dir, leg, "run", "exit"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.write("NOT-RUN\n")
+
+
+def _save_process_output(row_dir: str, leg: str, phase: str, stdout: bytes, stderr: bytes, exit_code: int | None = None) -> None:
+    with open(_output_path(row_dir, leg, phase, "stdout"), "wb") as stream:
+        stream.write(stdout)
+    with open(_output_path(row_dir, leg, phase, "stderr"), "wb") as stream:
+        stream.write(stderr)
+    if phase == "run":
+        with open(
+            _output_path(row_dir, leg, phase, "exit"),
+            "w",
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        ) as stream:
+            stream.write(f"{exit_code}\n")
+
+
+def _remove_success_scratch(paths: Sequence[str]) -> None:
+    for path in paths:
+        shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
+
+
+def _run_row(source: str, *, repo: str, compiler: str, work_root: str, nm_bin: str, build_timeout: float = BUILD_TIMEOUT, run_default_timeout: float = RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, run_heavy_timeout: float = RUN_HEAVY_TIMEOUT, disk_min_gb: float = DISK_MIN_GB) -> dict:
+    result = _empty_row(source, repo, work_root)
+    source_path = result["source"]
+    relpath = result["name"]
+    base = result["base"]
+    is_std = result["kind"] == "std"
+    row_dir = result["row_dir"]
+    run_timeout = run_timeout_for(
+        relpath,
+        run_default_timeout=run_default_timeout,
+        run_heavy_timeout=run_heavy_timeout,
+    )
+
+    _prepare_row_directory(row_dir)
+    check_disk_space(work_root, disk_min_gb)
+
+    bin_root = os.path.join(row_dir, "bin")
+    cache_p = os.path.join(row_dir, "cache_p")
+    cache_c = os.path.join(row_dir, "cache_c")
+    mods = os.path.join(row_dir, "mods")
+    sandbox = os.path.join(row_dir, "sandbox")
+    for directory in (bin_root, cache_p, cache_c, mods):
+        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
+
+    binaries = {
+        leg: os.path.join(bin_root, leg.lower(), base)
+        for leg in _BUILD_LEGS
+    }
+    for path in binaries.values():
+        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+
+    key_paths = {
+        "C1": os.path.join(row_dir, "k1.key"),
+        "C2": os.path.join(row_dir, "k2.key"),
+        "C3": os.path.join(row_dir, "k3.key"),
+    }
+    trace_paths = {
+        "P": os.path.join(row_dir, "P.trace"),
+        "C1": os.path.join(row_dir, "C1.trace"),
+        "C3": os.path.join(row_dir, "C3.trace"),
+    }
+
+    commands = {
+        "P": [
+            compiler,
+            "build",
+            "-Diyi_observe",
+            "--emit-iyimod",
+            mods,
+            "-o",
+            binaries["P"],
+            source_path,
+        ],
+        "C1": [
+            compiler,
+            "build",
+            "-Diyi_observe",
+            "--use-iyimod",
+            mods,
+            "--stale-key",
+            key_paths["C1"],
+            "-o",
+            binaries["C1"],
+            source_path,
+        ],
+        "C2": [
+            compiler,
+            "build",
+            "-Diyi_observe",
+            "--use-iyimod",
+            mods,
+            "--stale-key",
+            key_paths["C2"],
+            "-o",
+            binaries["C2"],
+            source_path,
+        ],
+        "C3": [
+            compiler,
+            "build",
+            "-Diyi_observe",
+            "--use-iyimod",
+            mods,
+            "--stale-key",
+            key_paths["C3"],
+            "-o",
+            binaries["C3"],
+            source_path,
+        ],
+    }
+
+    failures: list[str] = []
+    stop_reasons: list[str] = []
+    legs: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    missing_binaries: set[str] = set()
+
+    def fail(code: str, reason: str) -> None:
+        failures.append(f"{code}: {reason}")
+
+    for leg in _BUILD_LEGS:
+        warm = leg == "C3"
+        cache = cache_p if leg == "P" else cache_c
+        rc, stdout, stderr, timed_out = run_session_proc(
+            commands[leg],
+            cwd=repo,
+            env=clean_env(repo, cache, warm=warm),
+            timeout_sec=build_timeout,
+        )
+        _save_process_output(row_dir, leg, "build", stdout, stderr)
+        legs[leg] = {
+            "build": {
+                "argv": commands[leg],
+                "exit": rc,
+                "timed_out": timed_out,
+                "stdout": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "build", "stdout"),
+                "stderr": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "build", "stderr"),
+            },
+            "run": None,
+        }
+
+        if timed_out:
+            fail(
+                f"BUILD-TIMEOUT-{leg}",
+                f"{leg} build timed out after {build_timeout}s",
+            )
+        elif rc != 0:
+            stderr_text = stderr.decode(errors="replace")
+            detail = stderr_text[-300:]
+            fail(
+                f"BUILD-EXIT-{leg}",
+                f"{leg} build failed (exit {rc}): {detail}",
+            )
+            if leg == "C3" and "cannot name it" in stderr_text:
+                stop_reasons.append(
+                    "C3 warm consumer stderr contains 'cannot name it'"
+                )
+                fail(
+                    "C3-CANNOT-NAME",
+                    "C3 warm consumer stderr contains 'cannot name it'",
+                )
+        elif not os.path.isfile(binaries[leg]):
+            fail(
+                f"BUILD-MISSING-{leg}",
+                f"{leg} build exited 0 without binary {binaries[leg]}",
+            )
+            missing_binaries.add(leg)
+
+        if b"__iyi_effect_" in stdout or b"__iyi_effect_" in stderr:
+            fail(
+                f"BUILD-EFFECT-{leg}",
+                f"{leg} build output names __iyi_effect_",
+            )
+
+    key_documents: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    missing_keys = [
+        os.path.basename(path)
+        for path in key_paths.values()
+        if not os.path.isfile(path)
+    ]
+    if missing_keys:
+        fail(
+            "KEY-MISSING",
+            "one or more key files missing: " + ", ".join(sorted(missing_keys)),
+        )
+    else:
+        try:
+            for leg, path in key_paths.items():
+                with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+                    document = json.load(stream)
+                if not isinstance(document, dict):
+                    raise TypeError(f"{os.path.basename(path)} root is not an object")
+                key_documents[leg] = document
+        except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) as error:
+            fail("KEY-PARSE", f"key parse error: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
+
+    callpath = ""
+    not_reusable_count = 0
+    if len(key_documents) == 3:
+        for leg in ("C1", "C2", "C3"):
+            document = key_documents[leg]
+            key_name = {"C1": "k1", "C2": "k2", "C3": "k3"}[leg]
+            if document.get("phase") != "linked":
+                fail(
+                    f"KEY-PHASE-{key_name}",
+                    f"{key_name} phase is {document.get('phase')!r}, expected 'linked'",
+                )
+            reach = document.get("reach")
+            if not isinstance(reach, dict) or reach.get("checked") is not True:
+                fail(
+                    f"REACH-CHECKED-{key_name}",
+                    f"{key_name} reach.checked is not True",
+                )
+
+        callpaths = {
+            leg: document.get("portable", {}).get("callpath", "")
+            if isinstance(document.get("portable"), dict)
+            else ""
+            for leg, document in key_documents.items()
+        }
+        callpath = callpaths["C1"]
+        empty_callpaths = [leg for leg, value in callpaths.items() if not value]
+        if empty_callpaths:
+            fail(
+                "CALLPATH-EMPTY",
+                "callpath is empty for " + ", ".join(sorted(empty_callpaths)),
+            )
+        if len(set(callpaths.values())) != 1:
+            fail(
+                "CALLPATH-PARITY",
+                "callpath parity mismatch: "
+                + ", ".join(
+                    f"{leg}={value!r}" for leg, value in callpaths.items()
+                ),
+            )
+
+        mismatches: dict[str, object] = {}
+        for leg, document in key_documents.items():
+            reach = document.get("reach")
+            value = reach.get("mismatch") if isinstance(reach, dict) else None
+            if value:
+                mismatches[leg] = value
+        if mismatches:
+            fail(
+                "REACH-MISMATCH",
+                "reach mismatch non-empty: "
+                + ", ".join(
+                    f"{leg}={value!r}" for leg, value in mismatches.items()
+                ),
+            )
+
+        not_reusable = key_documents["C1"].get("not_reusable", [])
+        if not isinstance(not_reusable, list):
+            fail("NOT-REUSABLE-TYPE", "k1 not_reusable is not an array")
+        else:
+            not_reusable_count = len(not_reusable)
+
+    effect_symbols: list[str] = []
+    for leg in ("C1", "C2", "C3"):
+        if leg in missing_binaries:
+            continue
+        try:
+            symbols = check_defined_symbols(binaries[leg], nm_bin)
+        except RuntimeError as error:
+            fail(f"NM-ERROR-{leg}", f"{leg} symbol scan failed: {error}")
+            continue
+        if symbols:
+            tagged = [f"{leg}:{symbol}" for symbol in symbols]
+            effect_symbols.extend(tagged)
+            reason = f"defined __iyi_effect_ symbols found in {leg} binary: {symbols}"
+            fail(f"EFFECT-SYMBOL-{leg}", reason)
+            stop_reasons.append(reason)
+
+    run_results: dict[str, tuple[int, bytes, bytes, bool]] = {}
+    builds_ok = not failures and not stop_reasons
+
+    def reset_sandbox() -> str:
+        shutil.rmtree(sandbox, ignore_errors=True)
+        if is_std:
+            os.makedirs(sandbox, exist_ok=True)
+        else:
+            shutil.copytree(os.path.join(repo, "samples", "iyi"), sandbox)
+        return sandbox
+
+    run_effect_legs: set[str] = set()
+    if builds_ok:
+        for leg in _RUN_LEGS:
+            run_cwd = reset_sandbox()
+            extra = {"IYI_OBSERVE": trace_paths[leg]}
+            if is_std:
+                extra["IYI_FILE_SANDBOX"] = sandbox
+            cache = cache_p if leg == "P" else cache_c
+            rc, stdout, stderr, timed_out = run_session_proc(
+                [binaries[leg]],
+                cwd=run_cwd,
+                env=clean_env(repo, cache, warm=leg == "C3", extra=extra),
+                timeout_sec=run_timeout,
+            )
+            _save_process_output(
+                row_dir,
+                leg,
+                "run",
+                stdout,
+                stderr,
+                exit_code=rc,
+            )
+            run_results[leg] = (rc, stdout, stderr, timed_out)
+            legs[leg]["run"] = {
+                "argv": [binaries[leg]],
+                "cwd": run_cwd,
+                "exit": rc,
+                "timed_out": timed_out,
+                "stdout": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "run", "stdout"),
+                "stderr": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "run", "stderr"),
+                "exit_file": _output_path(row_dir, leg, "run", "exit"),
+            }
+            if timed_out:
+                fail(
+                    f"RUN-TIMEOUT-{leg}",
+                    f"{leg} run timed out after {run_timeout}s",
+                )
+            if b"__iyi_effect_" in stdout or b"__iyi_effect_" in stderr:
+                fail(
+                    f"RUN-EFFECT-{leg}",
+                    f"{leg} run output names __iyi_effect_",
+                )
+                run_effect_legs.add(leg)
+
+        for leg in _RUN_LEGS:
+            trace_path = trace_paths[leg]
+            if not os.path.isfile(trace_path) or os.path.getsize(trace_path) == 0:
+                fail(
+                    f"TRACE-EMPTY-{leg}",
+                    f"{leg} trace missing or empty ({trace_path})",
+                )
+
+        comparisons = (
+            ("P", "C1", "P-C1", "pc1"),
+            ("C1", "C3", "C1-C3", "c1c3"),
+        )
+        for left, right, code_tag, file_tag in comparisons:
+            left_result = run_results[left]
+            right_result = run_results[right]
+            if left_result[3] or right_result[3] or left in run_effect_legs or right in run_effect_legs:
+                continue
+            ok, message = compare_r1(
+                base,
+                left_result[0],
+                right_result[0],
+                left_result[1],
+                left_result[2],
+                right_result[1],
+                right_result[2],
+                repo,
+                row_dir,
+                file_tag,
+            )
+            if not ok:
+                fail(f"R1-{code_tag}", f"R-1 [{code_tag}] {message}")
+
+    p_result = run_results.get("P")
+    p_exit = p_result[0] if p_result is not None else None
+    c1_result = run_results.get("C1")
+    c3_result = run_results.get("C3")
+    p_nonzero = bool(
+        is_std
+        and p_result is not None
+        and not p_result[3]
+        and p_exit != 0
+    )
+
+    stop_condition = "; ".join(stop_reasons) if stop_reasons else None
+    status = "STOP" if stop_condition else ("PASS" if not failures else "FAIL")
+    scratch_paths = (bin_root, cache_p, cache_c, mods, sandbox)
+    if status == "PASS":
+        _remove_success_scratch(scratch_paths)
+
+    check_disk_space(work_root, disk_min_gb)
+
+    result.update(
+        {
+            "status": status,
+            "failures": failures,
+            "stop_condition": stop_condition,
+            "p_exit": p_exit,
+            "c1_exit": c1_result[0] if c1_result is not None else None,
+            "c3_exit": c3_result[0] if c3_result is not None else None,
+            "callpath": callpath,
+            "not_reusable_count": not_reusable_count,
+            "effect_symbols": effect_symbols,
+            "p_nonzero": p_nonzero,
+            "preserved_dir": row_dir if status != "PASS" else None,
+            "legs": legs,
+        }
+    )
+    return result
+
+
+def run_row(source: str, *, repo: str, compiler: str, work_root: str, nm_bin: str, build_timeout: float = BUILD_TIMEOUT, run_default_timeout: float = RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, run_heavy_timeout: float = RUN_HEAVY_TIMEOUT, disk_min_gb: float = DISK_MIN_GB) -> dict:
+    """Run one row, converting only OSError and RuntimeError at the row boundary."""
+    result = _empty_row(source, repo, work_root)
+    try:
+        return _run_row(
+            source,
+            repo=repo,
+            compiler=compiler,
+            work_root=work_root,
+            nm_bin=nm_bin,
+            build_timeout=build_timeout,
+            run_default_timeout=run_default_timeout,
+            run_heavy_timeout=run_heavy_timeout,
+            disk_min_gb=disk_min_gb,
+        )
+    except (OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
+        category = "OSERROR" if isinstance(error, OSError) else "RUNTIMEERROR"
+        code = f"ROW-{category}"
+        result["failures"] = [f"{code}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"]
+        result["status"] = "FAIL"
+        result["preserved_dir"] = result["row_dir"]
+        return result
+
+
+def run_rows(sources: Sequence[str], *, repo: str, compiler: str, work_root: str, nm_bin: str, workers: int, build_timeout: float = BUILD_TIMEOUT, run_default_timeout: float = RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, run_heavy_timeout: float = RUN_HEAVY_TIMEOUT, disk_min_gb: float = DISK_MIN_GB) -> list[dict]:
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
+        futures = [
+            pool.submit(
+                run_row,
+                source,
+                repo=repo,
+                compiler=compiler,
+                work_root=work_root,
+                nm_bin=nm_bin,
+                build_timeout=build_timeout,
+                run_default_timeout=run_default_timeout,
+                run_heavy_timeout=run_heavy_timeout,
+                disk_min_gb=disk_min_gb,
+            )
+            for source in sources
+        ]
+        results = [future.result() for future in futures]
+
+    for result in results:
+        extra = ""
+        if result["status"] != "PASS":
+            extra = f" -> {'; '.join(result['failures'])}"
+        elif result["p_nonzero"]:
+            extra = f" (p_nonzero exit={result['p_exit']})"
+        status_tag = f"[{result['status']}]"
+        print(f"  {status_tag:6s} {result['name']}{extra}")
+        sys.stdout.flush()
+    return results
+
+
+def write_report(report_path: str, rows: Sequence[dict]) -> None:
+    directory = os.path.dirname(report_path)
+    if directory:
+        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
+    with open(report_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+        for row in rows:
+            stream.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
+
+
+def _argument_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Run 2: all artifact legs (P, C1, C2, C3)"
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--compiler", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--work", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--workers", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--nm", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--expect-samples", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--expect-std", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--expect-total", required=True, type=int)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None, *, build_timeout: float = BUILD_TIMEOUT, run_default_timeout: float = RUN_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, run_heavy_timeout: float = RUN_HEAVY_TIMEOUT, disk_min_gb: float = DISK_MIN_GB) -> int:
+    parser = _argument_parser()
+    try:
+        args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    except SystemExit as error:
+        return int(error.code)
+
+    usage_error = "--workers must be at least 1" if args.workers < 1 else ("expected counts must be non-negative" if min(args.expect_samples, args.expect_std, args.expect_total) < 0 else "")
+    if usage_error:
+        print(f"artifact_legs: {usage_error}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    repo = os.path.realpath(args.repo)
+    compiler = os.path.realpath(args.compiler)
+    work = os.path.realpath(args.work)
+    report = os.path.realpath(args.report)
+    nm_bin = os.path.realpath(args.nm)
+    os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
+
+    samples = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(repo, "samples", "iyi", "*.iyi")))
+    std = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(repo, "bench", "std_*_exercise.iyi")))
+    sources = samples + std
+
+    count_failures: list[str] = []
+    if len(samples) != args.expect_samples:
+        count_failures.append(
+            f"samples={len(samples)}, expected={args.expect_samples}"
+        )
+    if len(std) != args.expect_std:
+        count_failures.append(f"std={len(std)}, expected={args.expect_std}")
+    if len(sources) != args.expect_total:
+        count_failures.append(
+            f"total={len(sources)}, expected={args.expect_total}"
+        )
+
+    print(
+        "Corpus counts: "
+        f"samples={len(samples)} expected={args.expect_samples}; "
+        f"std={len(std)} expected={args.expect_std}; "
+        f"total={len(sources)} expected={args.expect_total}"
+    )
+    if count_failures:
+        print(
+            "RUN 2 count mismatch: " + "; ".join(count_failures),
+            file=sys.stderr,
+        )
+
+    rows = run_rows(
+        sources,
+        repo=repo,
+        compiler=compiler,
+        work_root=work,
+        nm_bin=nm_bin,
+        workers=args.workers,
+        build_timeout=build_timeout,
+        run_default_timeout=run_default_timeout,
+        run_heavy_timeout=run_heavy_timeout,
+        disk_min_gb=disk_min_gb,
+    )
+    write_report(report, rows)
+    print(f"Report written to {report}")
+
+    passed = sum(row["status"] == "PASS" for row in rows)
+    stops = sum(row["status"] == "STOP" for row in rows)
+    failed = len(rows) - passed - stops
+    print(
+        "RUN 2 SUMMARY: "
+        f"total={len(rows)} passed={passed} failed={failed} stops={stops}"
+    )
+
+    if count_failures or failed or stops:
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Importable observed-corpus compiler shim for matching, execution, and ledger proof."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import dataclasses
+import fcntl
+import glob
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shlex
+import shutil
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import uuid
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from typing import NoReturn
+
+
+CONFIG_KEYS = frozenset(
+    {
+        "real",
+        "census",
+        "ledger",
+        "nonce",
+        "driver",
+        "work_tmp",
+        "scratch",
+        "repo",
+        "canonical_roots",
+        "platform_tmp",
+    }
+)
+HEADER_KEYS = frozenset({"v", "kind", "nonce", "driver", "attempt", "chain_id"})
+ENV_SEEN_KEYS = (
+    "IYI_PATH",
+    "CRYSTAL_PATH",
+    "IYI_CACHE_DIR",
+    "IYI_OPTS",
+    "CRYSTAL_OPTS",
+)
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class OptionSpec:
+    arity: int | tuple[int, int]
+    build_only: bool = False
+
+
+# Transcribed from create_compiler in src/compiler/iyi/command.cr:807-1138
+# and its target and warning option helpers at command.cr:1474-1522.
+OPTION_TABLE: dict[str, OptionSpec] = {
+    "--cross-compile": OptionSpec(0, build_only=True),
+    "-d": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--debug": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--no-debug": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--frame-pointers": OptionSpec(1),
+    "-D": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--define": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--emit": OptionSpec((0, 1)),
+    "--x86-asm-syntax": OptionSpec(1),
+    "-f": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--format": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--error-trace": OptionSpec(0),
+    "-h": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--help": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--ll": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--link-flags": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--mcpu": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--mattr": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--mcmodel": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--warnings": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--error-on-warnings": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--exclude-warnings": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--no-color": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--no-codegen": OptionSpec(0),
+    "-o": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--output": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--prelude": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--crystal": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--iyi-keep": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--emit-bind": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--emit-iyimod": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--use-iyimod": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--release": OptionSpec(0),
+    "-O": OptionSpec(1),
+    "-s": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--stats": OptionSpec(0),
+    "-p": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--progress": OptionSpec(0),
+    "-t": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--time": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--single-module": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--threads": OptionSpec(1),
+    "--target": OptionSpec(1, build_only=True),
+    "--verbose": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--static": OptionSpec(0),
+    "--force": OptionSpec(0, build_only=True),
+    "--stale-key": OptionSpec(1, build_only=True),
+    "--stale-accept": OptionSpec(1, build_only=True),
+    "--stale-block": OptionSpec(1, build_only=True),
+    "--stale-dump-elements": OptionSpec(1, build_only=True),
+    "--stdin-filename": OptionSpec(1),
+}
+
+UNCHANGED_EXACT = frozenset({"--crystal", "--no-codegen", "--emit"})
+PASSTHROUGH_EXACT = frozenset({"--emit-iyimod", "--use-iyimod"})
+
+
+class ShimError(RuntimeError):
+    """A closed refusal, not a proof-tool crash."""
+
+
+class ConfigError(ShimError):
+    pass
+
+
+class InvocationError(ShimError):
+    pass
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Invocation:
+    argv: tuple[str, ...]
+    command_word: str
+    command: str
+    compiler_args: tuple[str, ...]
+    run_args: tuple[str, ...]
+    sources: tuple[str, ...]
+    output: str | None
+    has_separator: bool
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CompilerEnvironment:
+    roots: tuple[str, ...]
+    cache_dir: str
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Classification:
+    mode: str
+    canonical: bool
+    first_noncanonical_root: str | None
+    variant_ids: tuple[str, ...]
+    variant_kind: str | None
+    bindings: dict[str, dict[str, str]]
+    status: str
+    reason: str | None
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ExecPlan:
+    real: str
+    argv: tuple[str, ...]
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _ChildResult:
+    rc: int
+    stdout: bytes
+    stderr: bytes
+    interrupted: int | None
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with open(path, "rb") as source:
+        while chunk := source.read(65536):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_config(path: str) -> dict:
+    try:
+        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
+            config = json.load(source)
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+        raise ConfigError(f"config unreadable: {error}") from error
+    if not isinstance(config, dict):
+        raise ConfigError("config is not an object")
+    keys = frozenset(config)
+    if keys != CONFIG_KEYS:
+        missing = sorted(CONFIG_KEYS - keys)
+        unknown = sorted(keys - CONFIG_KEYS)
+        raise ConfigError(f"config keys differ: missing={missing}, unknown={unknown}")
+    for key in CONFIG_KEYS - {"canonical_roots", "platform_tmp"}:
+        if not isinstance(config[key], str):
+            raise ConfigError(f"config {key} is not a string")
+    platform_tmp = config["platform_tmp"]
+    if platform_tmp is not None and not isinstance(platform_tmp, str):
+        raise ConfigError("config platform_tmp is not a string or null")
+    if isinstance(platform_tmp, str) and os.path.realpath(platform_tmp) != platform_tmp:
+        raise ConfigError("config platform_tmp is not a realpath")
+    roots = config["canonical_roots"]
+    if not isinstance(roots, list) or any(not isinstance(root, str) for root in roots):
+        raise ConfigError("config canonical_roots is not a string list")
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", config["nonce"]) is None:
+        raise ConfigError("config nonce is not 32 lowercase hex characters")
+    for key in ("real", "census", "work_tmp", "repo"):
+        if os.path.realpath(config[key]) != config[key]:
+            raise ConfigError(f"config {key} is not a realpath")
+    if not os.path.isabs(config["ledger"]) or not os.path.isabs(config["scratch"]):
+        raise ConfigError("config ledger and scratch must be absolute")
+    normalized_roots = [os.path.realpath(root) for root in roots]
+    if normalized_roots != roots:
+        raise ConfigError("config canonical_roots contains a non-realpath")
+    return config
+
+
+def read_header(ledger_path: str, *, nonce: str | None = None, driver: str | None = None) -> dict:
+    try:
+        with open(ledger_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
+            first = source.readline()
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as error:
+        raise ConfigError(f"ledger unavailable: {error}") from error
+    if not first:
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header is missing")
+    try:
+        header = json.loads(first)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
+        raise ConfigError(f"ledger header is invalid JSON: {error}") from error
+    if not isinstance(header, dict) or frozenset(header) != HEADER_KEYS:
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header shape is invalid")
+    if header.get("v") != 1 or header.get("kind") != "header":
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header version or kind is invalid")
+    if not isinstance(header.get("attempt"), int) or isinstance(header.get("attempt"), bool):
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header attempt is invalid")
+    if not isinstance(header.get("chain_id"), str) or not header["chain_id"]:
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header chain_id is invalid")
+    if nonce is not None and header.get("nonce") != nonce:
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header nonce does not match config")
+    if driver is not None and header.get("driver") != driver:
+        raise ConfigError("ledger header driver does not match config")
+    return header
+
+
+def _normalized_command(word: str) -> str:
+    if word and "build".startswith(word):
+        return "build"
+    if word == "run":
+        return "run"
+    return word
+
+
+def _arity_bounds(spec: OptionSpec) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    if isinstance(spec.arity, tuple):
+        return spec.arity
+    return spec.arity, spec.arity
+
+
+def _option(token: str) -> tuple[str, OptionSpec, str | None] | None:
+    direct = OPTION_TABLE.get(token)
+    if direct is not None:
+        return token, direct, None
+    if token.startswith("--") and "=" in token:
+        name, value = token.split("=", 1)
+        spec = OPTION_TABLE.get(name)
+        if spec is None or _arity_bounds(spec)[1] != 1:
+            return None
+        return name, spec, value
+    if token.startswith("-") and not token.startswith("--"):
+        for name in ("-D", "-o", "-O", "-f"):
+            if token.startswith(name) and token != name:
+                spec = OPTION_TABLE[name]
+                return name, spec, token[len(name) :]
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_invocation(argv: Sequence[str]) -> Invocation:
+    received = tuple(str(token) for token in argv)
+    if not received:
+        return Invocation((), "", "", (), (), (), None, False)
+    command_word = received[0]
+    command = _normalized_command(command_word)
+    if os.path.isfile(command_word) or command_word.endswith((".iyi", ".cr")):
+        raise InvocationError(f"implicit file form is unsupported: {command_word}")
+    if command not in ("build", "run"):
+        return Invocation(received, command_word, command, received[1:], (), (), None, False)
+
+    tail = list(received[1:])
+    if "--" in tail:
+        separator = tail.index("--")
+        before = tail[:separator]
+        run_args = tuple(tail[separator + 1 :])
+        has_separator = True
+    else:
+        before = tail
+        run_args = ()
+        has_separator = False
+    if command == "run" and "--sandbox" in before:
+        raise InvocationError("run --sandbox is unsupported")
+
+    sources: list[str] = []
+    output: str | None = None
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(before):
+        token = before[index]
+        if token.startswith("-") and token != "-":
+            matched = _option(token)
+            if matched is None:
+                raise InvocationError(f"unknown option: {token}")
+            name, spec, attached = matched
+            if (
+                spec.build_only
+                and command != "build"
+                and name != "--cross-compile"
+            ):
+                raise InvocationError(f"build-only option on run: {name}")
+            if name == "--stdin-filename":
+                raise InvocationError("--stdin-filename is unsupported")
+            minimum, maximum = _arity_bounds(spec)
+            if maximum == 0:
+                index += 1
+                continue
+            if attached is None:
+                if minimum == 0 and (
+                    index + 1 >= len(before)
+                    or _option(before[index + 1]) is not None
+                ):
+                    value = ""
+                    index += 1
+                else:
+                    if index + 1 >= len(before):
+                        raise InvocationError(f"option requires a value: {name}")
+                    value = before[index + 1]
+                    index += 2
+            else:
+                value = attached
+                index += 1
+            if name in ("-o", "--output"):
+                output = value
+            continue
+        sources.append(token)
+        index += 1
+
+    return Invocation(
+        argv=received,
+        command_word=command_word,
+        command=command,
+        compiler_args=tuple(before),
+        run_args=run_args,
+        sources=tuple(sources),
+        output=output,
+        has_separator=has_separator,
+    )
+
+
+def _tokenize_ambient_options() -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    tokens: list[str] = []
+    for name in ("IYI_OPTS", "CRYSTAL_OPTS"):
+        value = os.environ.get(name)
+        if value is None or value == "":
+            continue
+        try:
+            tokens.extend(shlex.split(value, posix=True))
+        except ValueError as error:
+            raise InvocationError(f"cannot parse {name}: {error}") from error
+    return tuple(tokens)
+
+def _recognized_option_tokens(tokens: Sequence[str], *, command: str, allow_positionals: bool) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    recognized: list[str] = []
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(tokens):
+        token = tokens[index]
+        if not token.startswith("-") or token == "-":
+            if not allow_positionals:
+                raise InvocationError("IYI_OPTS/CRYSTAL_OPTS may not contain positional arguments")
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        if token == "--":
+            raise InvocationError("IYI_OPTS/CRYSTAL_OPTS may not contain --")
+        matched = _option(token)
+        if matched is None:
+            raise InvocationError(f"unknown option: {token}")
+        name, spec, attached = matched
+        if (
+            spec.build_only
+            and command != "build"
+            and name != "--cross-compile"
+        ):
+            raise InvocationError(f"build-only option on run: {name}")
+        if name == "--stdin-filename":
+            raise InvocationError("--stdin-filename is unsupported")
+        recognized.append(token)
+        minimum, maximum = _arity_bounds(spec)
+        if maximum == 1 and attached is None:
+            if minimum == 0 and (
+                index + 1 >= len(tokens)
+                or _option(tokens[index + 1]) is not None
+            ):
+                index += 1
+            else:
+                if index + 1 >= len(tokens):
+                    raise InvocationError(f"option requires a value: {name}")
+                index += 2
+        else:
+            index += 1
+    return tuple(recognized)
+
+
+
+def compiler_env(real: str, cwd: str) -> CompilerEnvironment:
+    try:
+        completed = subprocess.run(
+            [real, "env", "IYI_PATH", "IYI_CACHE_DIR"],
+            cwd=cwd,
+            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+            check=False,
+        )
+    except OSError as error:
+        raise InvocationError(f"compiler env failed: {error}") from error
+    if completed.returncode != 0:
+        detail = completed.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
+        raise InvocationError(
+            f"compiler env exited {completed.returncode}: {detail or 'no stderr'}"
+        )
+    lines = completed.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
+    if len(lines) != 2:
+        raise InvocationError(f"compiler env returned {len(lines)} lines, expected 2")
+    path_value, cache_value = lines
+    roots: list[str] = []
+    for entry in path_value.split(os.pathsep):
+        if entry == "":
+            continue
+        candidate = entry if os.path.isabs(entry) else os.path.join(cwd, entry)
+        roots.append(os.path.realpath(candidate))
+    cache_candidate = cache_value if os.path.isabs(cache_value) else os.path.join(cwd, cache_value)
+    return CompilerEnvironment(tuple(roots), os.path.realpath(cache_candidate))
+
+
+def _realpath_from_cwd(path: str, cwd: str) -> str:
+    candidate = path if os.path.isabs(path) else os.path.join(cwd, path)
+    return os.path.realpath(candidate)
+
+
+def compute_out(invocation: Invocation, *, cwd: str, cache_dir: str, pid: int | None = None) -> str | None:
+    if invocation.command not in ("build", "run"):
+        return None
+    if invocation.output is not None:
+        return _realpath_from_cwd(invocation.output, cwd)
+    source = invocation.sources[0] if invocation.sources else "a.iyi"
+    stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(source))[0] or "a"
+    if invocation.command == "run":
+        if not cache_dir:
+            raise InvocationError("compiler env returned an empty IYI_CACHE_DIR")
+        runner_pid = os.getpid() if pid is None else pid
+        return os.path.realpath(
+            os.path.join(cache_dir, f"iyi-run-{stem}-{runner_pid}.tmp")
+        )
+    return os.path.realpath(os.path.join(cwd, stem))
+
+
+def _template_regex(template: str, *, variables: Mapping[str, object], bound: Mapping[str, str], work_tmp: str, repo: str, platform_tmp: str | None) -> tuple[re.Pattern[str], dict[str, str]]:
+    parts: list[str] = []
+    group_names: dict[str, str] = {}
+    position = 0
+    for placeholder in re.finditer(r"\{([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}", template):
+        parts.append(re.escape(template[position : placeholder.start()]))
+        name = placeholder.group(1)
+        if name == "REPO":
+            parts.append(re.escape(repo))
+        elif name == "WORK":
+            if name in bound:
+                parts.append(re.escape(bound[name]))
+            elif name in group_names:
+                parts.append(f"(?P={group_names[name]})")
+            else:
+                roots = [os.path.realpath(work_tmp)]
+                if platform_tmp is not None:
+                    roots.append(os.path.realpath(platform_tmp))
+                root_body = "|".join(
+                    re.escape(root) for root in dict.fromkeys(roots)
+                )
+                group_names[name] = "iyi_work"
+                parts.append(
+                    f"(?P<iyi_work>(?:{root_body}){re.escape(os.sep)}[^/]+)"
+                )
+        elif name in variables:
+            if name in bound:
+                parts.append(re.escape(bound[name]))
+            elif name in group_names:
+                parts.append(f"(?P={group_names[name]})")
+            else:
+                group_name = f"iyi_var_{len(group_names)}"
+                group_names[name] = group_name
+                declaration = variables[name]
+                if not isinstance(declaration, dict):
+                    raise ValueError(f"variable {name} declaration is not an object")
+                values = declaration.get("values")
+                pattern = declaration.get("pattern")
+                if isinstance(values, list) and values and all(
+                    isinstance(value, str) for value in values
+                ):
+                    body = "|".join(re.escape(value) for value in values)
+                elif isinstance(pattern, str) and pattern:
+                    body = pattern
+                else:
+                    raise ValueError(f"variable {name} has no values or pattern")
+                parts.append(f"(?P<{group_name}>{body})")
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown template placeholder {name}")
+        position = placeholder.end()
+    parts.append(re.escape(template[position:]))
+    return re.compile("".join(parts)), group_names
+
+
+def _match_template(template: object, actual: str, *, variables: Mapping[str, object], bindings: dict[str, str], work_tmp: str, repo: str, platform_tmp: str | None) -> bool:
+    if not isinstance(template, str):
+        return False
+    try:
+        expression, groups = _template_regex(
+            template,
+            variables=variables,
+            bound=bindings,
+            work_tmp=work_tmp,
+            repo=repo,
+            platform_tmp=platform_tmp,
+        )
+    except (ValueError, re.error):
+        return False
+    matched = expression.fullmatch(os.path.realpath(actual))
+    if matched is None:
+        return False
+    for name, group_name in groups.items():
+        bindings[name] = matched.group(group_name)
+    return True
+
+
+def match_variants(census: dict, command: str, first_root: str | None, sources: Sequence[str], output: str | None, work_tmp: str, repo: str, *, platform_tmp: str | None) -> tuple[str, list[str], str | None, dict[str, dict[str, str]]]:
+    if first_root is None:
+        return "unclassified", [], None, {}
+    normalized_work = os.path.realpath(work_tmp)
+    normalized_repo = os.path.realpath(repo)
+    normalized_sources = [os.path.realpath(source) for source in sources]
+    normalized_output = os.path.realpath(output) if output is not None else None
+    matches: list[tuple[str, str, dict[str, str]]] = []
+    for site in census.get("sites", []):
+        if not isinstance(site, dict) or site.get("command") != command:
+            continue
+        for variant in site.get("variants", []):
+            if not isinstance(variant, dict):
+                continue
+            variant_id = variant.get("id")
+            kind = variant.get("kind")
+            templates = variant.get("sources")
+            variables = variant.get("vars", {})
+            if (
+                not isinstance(variant_id, str)
+                or kind not in ("negative", "positive")
+                or not isinstance(templates, list)
+                or not isinstance(variables, dict)
+                or len(templates) != len(normalized_sources)
+            ):
+                continue
+            bindings: dict[str, str] = {}
+            if not _match_template(
+                variant.get("first_root"),
+                os.path.realpath(first_root),
+                variables=variables,
+                bindings=bindings,
+                work_tmp=normalized_work,
+                repo=normalized_repo,
+                platform_tmp=platform_tmp,
+            ):
+                continue
+            matched_all = True
+            for template, actual in zip(templates, normalized_sources):
+                if not _match_template(
+                    template,
+                    actual,
+                    variables=variables,
+                    bindings=bindings,
+                    work_tmp=normalized_work,
+                    repo=normalized_repo,
+                    platform_tmp=platform_tmp,
+                ):
+                    matched_all = False
+                    break
+            if not matched_all:
+                continue
+            output_template = variant.get("output")
+            if output_template is not None:
+                if normalized_output is None or not _match_template(
+                    output_template,
+                    normalized_output,
+                    variables=variables,
+                    bindings=bindings,
+                    work_tmp=normalized_work,
+                    repo=normalized_repo,
+                    platform_tmp=platform_tmp,
+                ):
+                    continue
+            declared_bindings = {
+                name: bindings[name]
+                for name in variables
+                if name in bindings
+            }
+            matches.append((variant_id, kind, declared_bindings))
+    if not matches:
+        return "unclassified", [], None, {}
+    kinds = {kind for _variant_id, kind, _bindings in matches}
+    ids = [variant_id for variant_id, _kind, _bindings in matches]
+    bindings_by_id = {
+        variant_id: variant_bindings
+        for variant_id, _kind, variant_bindings in matches
+    }
+    if len(kinds) != 1:
+        return "ambiguous", ids, None, bindings_by_id
+    return "matched", ids, next(iter(kinds)), bindings_by_id
+
+
+def _has_unchanged_trigger(tokens: Sequence[str]) -> bool:
+    for token in tokens:
+        if token in UNCHANGED_EXACT:
+            return True
+        if token.startswith("--emit=") or token.startswith("--emit-bind"):
+            return True
+        if token.startswith("--cross-compile"):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def _has_passthrough_trigger(tokens: Sequence[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(
+        token in PASSTHROUGH_EXACT
+        or token.startswith("--emit-iyimod=")
+        or token.startswith("--use-iyimod=")
+        for token in tokens
+    )
+
+
+def classify(census: dict, invocation: Invocation, roots: Sequence[str], canonical_roots: Sequence[str], sources: Sequence[str], output: str | None, work_tmp: str, repo: str, *, platform_tmp: str | None, ambient_tokens: Sequence[str] = ()) -> Classification:
+    normalized_roots = tuple(os.path.realpath(root) for root in roots)
+    canonical_set = {os.path.realpath(root) for root in canonical_roots}
+    first_noncanonical = next(
+        (root for root in normalized_roots if root not in canonical_set),
+        None,
+    )
+    canonical = first_noncanonical is None
+    if invocation.command not in ("build", "run"):
+        return Classification(
+            "unchanged", canonical, first_noncanonical, (), None, {}, "unchanged", None
+        )
+    trigger_tokens = (
+        *_recognized_option_tokens(
+            invocation.compiler_args,
+            command=invocation.command,
+            allow_positionals=True,
+        ),
+        *_recognized_option_tokens(
+            ambient_tokens,
+            command=invocation.command,
+            allow_positionals=False,
+        ),
+    )
+    if _has_unchanged_trigger(trigger_tokens):
+        return Classification(
+            "unchanged", canonical, first_noncanonical, (), None, {}, "unchanged", None
+        )
+    if _has_passthrough_trigger(trigger_tokens):
+        return Classification(
+            "passthrough", canonical, first_noncanonical, (), None, {}, "passthrough", None
+        )
+    if canonical:
+        return Classification(
+            "roundtrip", True, None, (), None, {}, "canonical", "canonical roots"
+        )
+    status, variant_ids, kind, bindings = match_variants(
+        census,
+        invocation.command,
+        first_noncanonical,
+        sources,
+        output,
+        work_tmp,
+        repo,
+        platform_tmp=platform_tmp,
+    )
+    if status != "matched":
+        return Classification(
+            "refused",
+            False,
+            first_noncanonical,
+            tuple(variant_ids),
+            kind,
+            bindings,
+            status,
+            f"{status} variant match",
+        )
+    mode = "roundtrip" if kind == "positive" else "observed-negative"
+    return Classification(
+        mode,
+        False,
+        first_noncanonical,
+        tuple(variant_ids),
+        kind,
+        bindings,
+        status,
+        f"matched {kind} variant",
+    )
+
+
+def _observe_definitions(tokens: Sequence[str]) -> int:
+    count = 0
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(tokens):
+        token = tokens[index]
+        if token == "-D" or token == "--define":
+            if index + 1 < len(tokens) and tokens[index + 1] == "iyi_observe":
+                count += 1
+            index += 2
+            continue
+        if token == "-Diyi_observe" or token == "--define=iyi_observe":
+            count += 1
+        index += 1
+    return count
+
+
+def _with_observe(invocation: Invocation, *, ambient_tokens: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[str]:
+    tokens = list(invocation.argv)
+    if _observe_definitions((*invocation.compiler_args, *ambient_tokens)) == 0:
+        tokens.insert(1, "-Diyi_observe")
+    return tokens
+
+
+def build_exec_argv(invocation: Invocation, *, ambient_tokens: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[str]:
+    return _with_observe(invocation, ambient_tokens=ambient_tokens)
+
+
+def build_producer_argv(invocation: Invocation, mods: str, output: str, *, ambient_tokens: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[str]:
+    tokens = [invocation.command_word]
+    if _observe_definitions((*invocation.compiler_args, *ambient_tokens)) == 0:
+        tokens.append("-Diyi_observe")
+    tokens.extend(("--emit-iyimod", mods))
+    tokens.extend(invocation.compiler_args)
+    if invocation.command == "run" and invocation.output is None:
+        tokens.extend(("-o", output))
+    return tokens
+
+
+def build_consumer_argv(invocation: Invocation, mods: str, output: str, *, ambient_tokens: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[str]:
+    tokens = [invocation.command_word]
+    if _observe_definitions((*invocation.compiler_args, *ambient_tokens)) == 0:
+        tokens.append("-Diyi_observe")
+    tokens.extend(("--use-iyimod", mods))
+    tokens.extend(invocation.compiler_args)
+    if invocation.command == "run" and invocation.output is None:
+        tokens.extend(("-o", output))
+    return tokens
+

+def write_record(ledger_path: str, record: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
+    encoded = (
+        json.dumps(dict(record), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    descriptor = os.open(ledger_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_APPEND)
+    try:
+        fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+        os.write(descriptor, encoded)
+    finally:
+        try:
+            fcntl.flock(descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
+        finally:
+            os.close(descriptor)
+

+def _base_record(config: Mapping[str, object], invocation: Invocation, classification: Classification, roots: Sequence[str], sources: Sequence[str], output: str | None, *, inv: str, phase: str, reason: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
+    driver = str(config["driver"])

+    )

+def _minimal_refusal_classification(reason: str) -> Classification:
+    return Classification(
+        "refused", False, None, (), None, {}, "refused", reason
+    )

+def _record_refusal(config: Mapping[str, object], invocation: Invocation, reason: str, *, inv: str, roots: Sequence[str] = (), sources: Sequence[str] = (), output: str | None = None, classification: Classification | None = None) -> int:
+    refused = classification or _minimal_refusal_classification(reason)

+def _run_build(argv: Sequence[str], *, capture: bool) -> _ChildResult:
+    stdout = subprocess.PIPE if capture else None
+    stderr = subprocess.PIPE if capture else None
+    process = subprocess.Popen(
+        list(argv),
+        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+        stdout=stdout,
+        stderr=stderr,
+    )
+    interrupted: list[int | None] = [None]
+    old_handlers: dict[int, object] = {}
+
+    def forward(number: int, _frame: object) -> None:
+        if interrupted[0] is None:
+            interrupted[0] = number
+        if process.poll() is None:
+            process.send_signal(number)
+
+    try:
+        for candidate in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGHUP):
+            old_handlers[candidate] = signal.getsignal(candidate)
+            signal.signal(candidate, forward)
+        out, err = process.communicate()
+    finally:
+        for candidate, handler in old_handlers.items():
+            signal.signal(candidate, handler)
+    return _ChildResult(
+        process.returncode,
+        out or b"",
+        err or b"",
+        interrupted[0],
+    )
+
+
+def _death_sentence(number: int) -> str:
+    if number in {
+        getattr(signal, "SIGSEGV", -2),
+        getattr(signal, "SIGBUS", -3),
+    }:
+        return (
+            "the program died of a memory fault. Outside `Pointer`, an iyi program "
+            "cannot reach memory it does not own: if the program uses `Pointer`, "
+            "that is the place to look, and on a target without iyi's runtime it "
+            "can also be the stack running out. If neither, it is a bug in iyi's "
+            "own runtime, and ours to fix: https://github.com/iyilang/iyi/issues"
+        )
+    if number == getattr(signal, "SIGINT", -1):
+        description = "was interrupted"
+    elif number == getattr(signal, "SIGILL", -4):
+        description = "terminated because of an invalid instruction"
+    elif number == getattr(signal, "SIGFPE", -5):
+        description = "terminated because of a floating-point system exception"
+    else:
+        try:
+            name = signal.Signals(number).name.removeprefix("SIG")
+        except ValueError:
+            name = str(number)
+        description = f"received and didn't handle signal {name} ({number})"
+    return f"the program was killed by signal {number} ({description})"
+
+
+def _run_program(argv: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[int, int | None]:
+    process = subprocess.Popen(list(argv))
+    old_handlers: dict[int, object] = {
+        signal.SIGINT: signal.getsignal(signal.SIGINT),
+        signal.SIGTERM: signal.getsignal(signal.SIGTERM),
+        signal.SIGHUP: signal.getsignal(signal.SIGHUP),
+    }
+
+    def forward(number: int, _frame: object) -> None:
+        if process.poll() is None:
+            process.send_signal(number)
+
+    try:
+        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
+        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, forward)
+        signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, forward)
+        rc = process.wait()
+    finally:
+        for candidate, handler in old_handlers.items():
+            signal.signal(candidate, handler)
+    if rc >= 0:
+        return rc, None
+    number = -rc
+    sys.stderr.write(f"iyi: {_death_sentence(number)}\n")
+    sys.stderr.flush()
+    return 1, number
+
+
+def _write_bytes(stream: object, data: bytes) -> None:
+    binary = getattr(stream, "buffer", None)
+    if binary is not None:
+        binary.write(data)
+        binary.flush()
+    else:
+        stream.write(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
+        stream.flush()
+
+
+def _end_record(begin: Mapping[str, object], *, producer: Mapping[str, object], consumer: Mapping[str, object] | None, run: Mapping[str, object] | None, out_ref: str | None, out_ino: int | None, out_mtime_ns: int | None, atime_set_ns: int | None, e3_error: str | None, interrupted: bool, exit_code: int) -> dict[str, object]:
+    record = dict(begin)
+    record.update(
+        {
+            "t_ns": time.monotonic_ns(),
+            "phase": "end",
+            "producer": dict(producer),
+            "consumer": dict(consumer) if consumer is not None else None,
+            "run": dict(run) if run is not None else None,
+            "out_ref": out_ref,
+            "out_ino": out_ino,
+            "out_mtime_ns": out_mtime_ns,
+            "atime_set_ns": atime_set_ns,
+            "e3_error": e3_error,
+            "interrupted": interrupted,
+            "exit": exit_code,
+        }
+    )
+    return record
+
+
+def run_roundtrip(config: Mapping[str, object], invocation: Invocation, classification: Classification, output: str, *, roots: Sequence[str], sources: Sequence[str], ambient_tokens: Sequence[str], inv: str) -> int:
+    invocation_dir = os.path.join(str(config["scratch"]), inv)
+    mods = os.path.join(invocation_dir, "mods")
+    os.makedirs(mods, exist_ok=False)
+    producer_args = [
+        str(config["real"]),
+        *build_producer_argv(
+            invocation,
+            mods,
+            output,
+            ambient_tokens=ambient_tokens,
+        ),
+    ]
+    consumer_args = [
+        str(config["real"]),
+        *build_consumer_argv(
+            invocation,
+            mods,
+            output,
+            ambient_tokens=ambient_tokens,
+        ),
+    ]
+    begin = _base_record(
+        config,
+        invocation,
+        classification,
+        roots,
+        sources,
+        output,
+        inv=inv,
+        phase="begin",
+    )
+    write_record(str(config["ledger"]), begin)
+
+    producer_result = _run_build(producer_args, capture=True)
+    mods_count = len(glob.glob(os.path.join(mods, "**", "*.iyimod"), recursive=True))
+    producer = {
+        "argv": producer_args,
+        "rc": producer_result.rc,
+        "mods_count": mods_count,
+    }
+    if producer_result.interrupted is not None or producer_result.rc != 0:
+        interrupted = producer_result.interrupted is not None
+        exit_code = (
+            128 + producer_result.interrupted
+            if producer_result.interrupted is not None
+            else producer_result.rc
+        )
+        if not interrupted:
+            _write_bytes(sys.stdout, producer_result.stdout)
+            _write_bytes(sys.stderr, producer_result.stderr)
+        shutil.rmtree(invocation_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+        end = _end_record(
+            begin,
+            producer=producer,
+            consumer=None,
+            run=None,
+            out_ref=None,
+            out_ino=None,
+            out_mtime_ns=None,

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run the observed-corpus proof chain.
+
+Commands and arguments:
+  plan --p P --w W --compiler C
+      Validate pin inputs without writing a report.
+  pin --report-dir R --p P --w W --compiler C
+      Create the immutable pin for a new chain.
+  run1 --report-dir R
+      Run gates 1.1 through 1.4, exclusions, and baseline skip capture.
+      Gate 1.3 runs bench/stale_rg9.py and requires canonical summary:
+      ^RG9 PASSED: {corpus} corpus programs, plain and observed legs (two processes plus IYI_WARM=1)$
+  run2 --report-dir R
+      Run all artifact legs with the pinned compiler and nm.
+  run3 --report-dir R [--driver DRIVER]
+      Run every required observed driver, or one required driver.
+  final --report-dir R
+      Recompute every latest result and publish final.json.
+  all --report-dir R
+      Run run1, run2, run3, and final in dependency order.
+
+Stage statuses are PASS, FAIL, STOP, PARTIAL, ENV-BLOCKED,
+NOT-ROUNDTRIPPED, MISCLASSIFIED, DIVERGENCE, UNFAITHFUL,
+NOT-EXERCISED, TIMEOUT, INVALID, CENSUS-MISSING, NOT-EXECUTED,
+OUT-MODIFIED, and STALE. Exit 0 means PASS, exit 1 means a recorded
+non-PASS status, and exit 2 means usage or configuration refusal.
+
+R has pin.json; run1/a<N>/ and run2/a<N>/; run3/required.json;
+run3/<driver>/a<N>/; and final.json. Every attempt ends with an atomic
+result.json. Attempt numbers are append-only. final uses the numerically
+highest attempt, recomputes its status from required checks, re-derives the
+required drivers from the latest Run 1 and Run 2, and requires every Run 3
+attempt to be newer than both. It verifies chain, unit, attempt and pinned
+identity, and lists every earlier failure. A chain is bound to the
+report-directory suffix and pin identity. On Darwin the pin records and
+probes the real platform temp root used by bare mktemp.
+INVALID recovery requires a new pin and report directory.

+def _read_run2_rows(path: str) -> list[dict]:
+    rows: list[dict] = []
+    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
+        for number, line in enumerate(source, 1):
+            if not line.strip():
+                continue
+            try:
+                row = json.loads(line)
+            except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid run2 row {number}: {error}") from error
+            if not isinstance(row, dict):
+                raise ValueError(f"run2 row {number} is not an object")
+            rows.append(row)
+    return rows

+def _driver_from_program(program: str) -> str | None:
+    base = os.path.basename(program)
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"std_(.+)_exercise\.iyi", base)
+    return match.group(1) if match else None

+def _compute_required_drivers(drivers: Sequence[str], exclusions_path: str, run2_path: str) -> list[str]:
+    required = list(dict.fromkeys(drivers))
+    exclusions = _load_json(exclusions_path)
+    if not isinstance(exclusions, list):
+        raise ValueError("exclusions.json is not a list")
+    additions: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in exclusions:
+        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
+            raise ValueError("exclusions.json contains a non-object")
+        program = entry.get("program")
+        if not isinstance(program, str):
+            raise ValueError("exclusion has no string program")
+        if program.startswith("bench/std_"):
+            driver = _driver_from_program(program)
+            if driver:
+                additions.add(driver)
+    for row in _read_run2_rows(run2_path):
+        if row.get("p_nonzero") is True:
+            base = row.get("base")
+            name = row.get("name")
+            candidate = base if isinstance(base, str) else name
+            if not isinstance(candidate, str):
+                raise ValueError("p_nonzero row has no base or name")
+            driver = _driver_from_program(candidate)
+            if driver is None:
+                driver = re.sub(r"^std_", "", os.path.basename(candidate))
+                driver = re.sub(r"_exercise(?:\.iyi)?$", "", driver)
+            if driver:
+                additions.add(driver)
+    for driver in sorted(additions):
+        if driver not in required:
+            required.append(driver)
+    return required
+

+def _classify_driver_skips(census: dict, log_text: str, baseline: set[tuple[str, str, str, str]]) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
+    hits = _skip_hits(census, log_text)
+    hit_keys = {
+        (hit["driver"], hit["class"], hit["what"], hit["regex"])
+        for hit in hits
+    }
+    tool_hits = [hit for hit in hits if hit["class"] == "tool"]
+    missing = sorted(hit_keys - baseline)
+    reasons = [
+        f"platform limit {hit['driver']}: {hit['what']}"
+        for hit in hits
+        if hit["class"] == "platform"
+    ]
+    if tool_hits:
+        reasons.extend(
+            f"tool skip {hit['driver']}: {hit['what']}" for hit in tool_hits
+        )
+        return "ENV-BLOCKED", reasons
+    if missing:
+        reasons.append(f"skip hits absent from baseline: {missing}")
+        return "PARTIAL", reasons
+    return "PASS", reasons
